artifact_kind: decision + amendment to the freeze. Recorded BEFORE the red P1 assertion is touched.
ordering_matters_here: This record is written before the assertion changes, so the criterion cannot be reverse-engineered from the branch that happened to be green. P1 ran against the populated bank by accident of construction, not by design; the decision below is made on grounds that would have selected it either way.
DECISION: The PARETO-1 world table is pinned to the POPULATED bank family — `state::fixtures::authority_reading(kl_p99, route_flips)`, with `route_weight_mass_moved`, `top10_mass_displaced` and `top1_mass_displaced` all present. Candidates therefore classify `MoveClass::Priced` at tier 2.

RATIONALE_independent_of_the_observed_re.primary: PARETO-1 isolates VALUE-SENSITIVE PREFERENCE. It does not study missing-evidence behaviour. The nulled bank introduces three deliberately absent authority quantities and makes `Unscorable` an incidental property of the fixture rather than a fact about the move — an extra condition the claim does not need and did not ask for.
RATIONALE_independent_of_the_observed_re.secondary: A reviewer of a nulled-bank result can reasonably ask whether the preference change depends on the fixture being INCOMPLETE. There is no gain from carrying that ambiguity into a result whose whole point is that accepted values, and nothing else, moved the decision.
RATIONALE_independent_of_the_observed_re.tertiary: The populated bank is authority-SHAPED, so it is the evidence path the real numerical successor will use. The synthetic-to-real progression becomes: synthetic accepted values -> complete authority-shaped bank -> existing assessment -> same Priced tier -> proxy frontier -> preference changes. The nulled variant inserts an intentionally incomplete bank into that chain and would have to be unwound later.
RATIONALE_independent_of_the_observed_re.what_is_preserved_either_way: The populated bank still leaves EXACTLY the two intended diagnostic ordering dimensions free — `KlP99` and `RouteFlipRate` — to decide W1, W2 and C1. Completeness at authority scale does not add ordering dimensions at diagnostic scale, because `route_cal_1()` marks `RouteMixtureMassP99` and `Top10MassDisplacedP99` `Unusable` there and `Top1MassDisplaced` is unregistered.
RATIONALE_independent_of_the_observed_re.counterfactual_test_of_the_criterion: Had P1 observed `Unscorable/tier 1` under the populated bank and `Priced/tier 2` under the nulled one, this criterion would still have selected the populated bank. The criterion is 'minimise fixture-only missingness and resemble the successor's evidence path', not 'match the observation'.

WHAT_IS_NOT_ERASED.keep: `c35d2385` stands as the scored falsification and is not rewritten.
WHAT_IS_NOT_ERASED.the_record: prediction `Unscorable/tier 1`; observed `Priced/tier 2`; cause: the prediction was reasoned from `Fixture::observed` while P1 was instantiated through `authority_reading`.
WHAT_IS_NOT_ERASED.why: The forecast was wrong for a real and transferable reason. Deleting it would delete the lesson that `MoveClass` is a property of the bank builder, not of the move.

AMENDED_P1_EXPECTATION.supersedes: The P1 clause of the freeze and the `Unscorable`/tier-1 expectation in the P2 finding.
assertions: `gpu_ms_saved` EQUAL across the two candidates, pinned to exactly `2.0`
AMENDED_P1_EXPECTATION.why_2_0_is_preregistered_not_observed: It is fully determined by the frozen facts. The cost observation gives beta = ((10.0 - 8.0)/10.0) / ((32768 - 24576)/32768) = 0.2/0.25 = 0.8. The parent ledger removes nothing, so its predicted cost is 10.0 * (1 - 0.8*0.0) = 10.0. Each child ledger removes 8,192 of 32,768 bytes, so fraction_removed = 0.25 and predicted cost is 10.0 * (1 - 0.8*0.25) = 8.0. gpu_ms_saved = 10.0 - 8.0 = 2.0 on both. Nothing is read off a run.
AMENDED_P1_EXPECTATION.what_pinning_it_buys: The physical inertness W1, W2 and C1 depend on stops being a stipulation and becomes a preregistered arithmetic fact. If a later edit to the ledgers or the cost observation breaks that equality, those three worlds silently stop being controlled — and this assertion fails first.

EDITORIAL_CONSTRAINT_ON_HOW_THE_RESULT_I.rule: PARETO-1 does NOT test `ranking_score` or `within`. The claim stays at the level of `decide_promotion`.
EDITORIAL_CONSTRAINT_ON_HOW_THE_RESULT_I.the_mechanism_as_claimed: stage 1 admits BOTH candidates into the same tier; the ordinal proxy frontier decides W1 and W2; the frontier REFUSES C1; physical gain decides C2; exact indistinguishability refuses C3.
EDITORIAL_CONSTRAINT_ON_HOW_THE_RESULT_I.why_this_matters_now: `decision.rs` records that `RankingScore.within` falls back to `gpu_ms_saved` for any non-`Priced` class. At `Priced` it does not. `within` can therefore change without any part of the claimed causal mechanism changing, because `decide_promotion` compares pairwise and never reads it. A narrative phrased in terms of `within` or `ranking_score` would be describing a quantity the claim does not rest on.

WHAT_P1_ACTUALLY_ESTABLISHED: Stronger than the mistaken class forecast: both candidates reach the same frontier with EQUAL physical gain. That is the precondition PARETO-1 needed — stage 1 cannot separate them, and stage 5 cannot separate them either, so in W1, W2 and C1 only the accepted quality values can.
